title: Confirm hook blocks a staged synthetic bad commit and allows clean commits (existing hook, default config)
description: Reverified 2026-10-20 using the exact existing installed hook in a disposable repository: clean fixture commits with receipt; a generated synthetic sensitive fixture is rejected, leaves HEAD unchanged, and does not expose its value. Both partial-staging directions are covered. Current staged changes also passed inspection through temporary index/object storage, preserving the real index/history. Acceptance evidence is complete locally; new product source remains unpublished. Existing closed status is retained.
